items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 69:1
items.html: The AHP that rose within ZA of Atzilut are of the phase of the new Kab, and are considered the phase of the vessels of the face of Nekudim, as above in answer 63. However, the phase of AHP that served at the time of the Kings, before the breaking of the vessels, has not yet been corrected in Atzilut, as is known; therefore ZA of Atzilut is discerned, in comparison to the ZA of Nekudim, as lacking his phase of AHP — that is, the NHY of the time of the Kings. In this respect ZA is called “a cripple,” meaning that he lacks AHP, which are the legs.
